The first elected mayor of Kathmandu in 1953 was Tulsi Lal Amatya, chosen by the municipal council in an indirect election. The team note naming Janak Man Shrestha conflicts with this, and I don't recognise that name as a Kathmandu mayor, so I haven't adopted it. I still can't check a source in this session, so please confirm against Wikipedia's list of Kathmandu mayors or a municipal history.
